About Pupsi Phull

Operator, adviser and transformation leader.

I have spent more than two decades leading operations, supply chains, commercial portfolios and business change across industrial distribution, logistics and regulated medical devices.

My perspective

Strategy has to survive contact with operations.

I am a senior Operations and Supply Chain Director with experience across industrial distribution, global logistics, express services, cold chain and regulated medical devices.

My work combines P&L leadership, supply-chain strategy, commercial design, digital transformation and sustainable operations. I focus on the point where evidence must become a decision, and where a decision must become a repeatable operating rhythm.

In regulated MedTech, I have led end-to-end supply-chain operations across planning, procurement, inventory, warehousing, logistics and digital transformation within ISO 13485, MDR and FDA/QSR environments.

Career story

Commercial scope with an operator’s view.

At RS Group, I held two senior Director roles with distinct scopes. As Operations Director, I carried £100m P&L accountability across a 16-site national network. As Value Added Solutions and Technical Director, I led a £230m revenue portfolio across four technical service lines.

At DHL GlobalMatch, I led commercial and strategy work for a £75m postal logistics portfolio. Cross-functional commercial and legal frameworks enabled approximately £20m in new business.

Earlier work at The DX Group included ERP-enabled transformation, customer-solutions leadership and operating-model change. That experience shaped a practical view of technology: the value sits in better decisions and better work, not in the system alone.

I look for the system behind the symptom, then make the route to action visible.

Sector experience

Patterns that transfer across boundaries.

I have worked in environments with different products, regulation and operating models. The transferable pattern is disciplined: understand the system, define the decision, involve the people who run it and make improvement measurable.
